caption: Fig. 2.7 (a) The spectrum of electromagnetic radiation. (b) Visible spectrum. The visible region is only a small part of the entire spectrum.
note: Two-part figure. Labels listed top-left to bottom-right: upper frequency scale (ν/Hz) tick values, then the (a) band names left to right, the 'Radio waves' sub-bracket printed under FM/AM, the lower wavelength scale (λ/m) tick values, then panel (b) with its 400-750 nm scale. All powers of ten are printed as superscripts on the page; written here with '^' so the exponent is not lost (e.g. '10^-16' is printed 10 with superscript -16). Greek letters γ, ν and λ are as printed. The displayed equation c = ν λ (2.5) at the top of the crop and the '2024-25' page footer at the bottom fall outside target_box_in_crop and are excluded as other blocks' content.
